title: Charter yacht check-in: documents, inspection and inventory
lead: The first afternoon of a charter decides how smoothly the week goes and whether you get your deposit back. Here is the check-in step by step: papers at the office, the base briefing and your own inspection of the boat.
description: How to check in on a charter yacht: documents and deposit, the base briefing, inspecting hull, sails, rigging, engine, anchor, dinghy and safety gear, recording damage, the crew briefing and check-out.
summary: Bring your skipper licence and the crew's passport details, and send the crew list before you arrive.
Inspect the boat yourself with the checklist: hull, sails, rigging, engine, anchor, dinghy, safety gear and inventory.
Photograph every scratch and fault, and have the base write it on the check-in list before you sign.
Brief your crew before you leave the berth, and return the boat on time with full tanks.
